# P3 power re-run for the D-nat Tier 1 tests with the expansion (generated by analysis/p3_power_tier1.py)

Dev pilots only (cloud/p3c_sequence.sh, F5 at t*). Scopes, scenarios and tests: see the script docstring. δ = 3 pp; power at α/6 | α/9; 4000 simulations (H1b GEE check: 100). 'none' = infeasible: the effect needs more one-way discordant mass than the scenario has. **Central** rows are marked.

## Qwen3-4B

Runs: `p2-exp01-dev-tstar-4B-6cd867e`, `p2-exp01-dev-ext-4B-6cd867e`. Dev items with every condition: gsm8k 264, math500 100, math_ext 900 (incomplete: 0). Test sizes: gsm8k 1055, math500 400, math_ext 3597.

Reproduction of the P2 run `p2-exp01-dev-4B-f7e5011` on the threshold-free 1A conditions (B1, F0, F1, F2, F2-scratch, F3(p)): 3276 of 3276 rows with the identical generated text, 3276 with the same label (different batch composition; VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1).
